content_sections.text: Before applying for CGSSB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026, candidates should check the educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility conditions for their preferred engineering discipline. content_sections.heading: CGSSB Sub Engineer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The CGSSB Sub Engineer Selection Process 2026 includes a written recruitment examination scheduled for 14 March 2027. The short notification does not provide a complete stage-wise selection procedure, examination marking scheme or final merit calculation method. The Board will publish the examination instructions and recruitment conditions separately. The short notice also states that appointments against the advertised posts will be subject to the final order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in SLP(C) No. 19668/2022.

content_sections.heading: CGSSB Sub Engineer Exam Date 2027
content_sections.text: The Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board has scheduled the CGSSB Sub Engineer written examination for 14 March 2027. The examination will be conducted for recruitment to 215 Sub Engineer posts in Civil, Electrical and Electrical/Mechanical disciplines. The examination timing, centres, reporting instructions and admit card release date will be announced separately.

content_sections.heading: CGSSB Sub Engineer Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The detailed CGSSB Sub Engineer exam pattern and syllabus have not been published in the short notification. The Board has stated that the examination instructions and syllabus will be made available separately on the official website. Candidates should refer to the detailed notification to confirm the examination subjects, technical syllabus, total questions, maximum marks, duration, negative marking and qualifying criteria. Separate technical requirements may apply to Civil, Electrical and Electrical/Mechanical posts.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced for CGSSB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 215 Sub Engineer vacancies have been announced, including 197 Civil, 17 Electrical and one Electrical/Mechanical post.

faq.question: Q2. When was the CGSSB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026 short notification released?
faq.answer: The Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board issued the short recruitment notification on 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the CGSSB Sub Engineer Exam Date 2027?
faq.answer: The written recruitment examination is scheduled for 14 March 2027, according to the official short notification.

faq.question: Q4. How many Civil Sub Engineer vacancies are available in CGSSB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 197 Sub Engineer (Civil) vacancies have been announced.

faq.question: Q5. How many Electrical Sub Engineer vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The notification announces 17 Sub Engineer (Electrical) vacancies and one separate Sub Engineer (Electrical/Mechanical) vacancy.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification for CGSSB Sub Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact educational qualifications have not been specified in the short notification. Candidates should check the detailed recruitment advertisement for the accepted qualifications.

faq.question: Q7. Are there any specific conditions regarding the final selection list?
faq.answer: Yes, the selection list will be subject to the final order of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of New Delhi in L.P.C. No. 19668 of 2022.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for the CGSSB Sub Engineer 2026 notification?
faq.answer: The recruitment notification has been released under the advertisement number 01 / S.S.B. / Exam / 2026/2342 issued by the board.

faq.question: Q9. What are the specific posts available under this CGSSB recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The vacancies are distributed among Sub Engineer (Civil) with 197 posts, Sub Engineer (Electrical) with 17 posts, and Sub Engineer (Electrical & Mechanical) with 1 post.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for CGSSB Sub Engineer positions?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a written competitive examination conducted by the Chhattisgarh Staff Selection Board at designated test centers.
